title: GRC Analyst Roadmap
summary: A four-year engineering path focused on governance, risk management, compliance, cybersecurity frameworks, security policies, audits, third-party risk, privacy and communicating technology risk to business stakeholders.

facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes a four-year B.Tech/B.E. programme beginning in 2026 and graduating around 2030.

about.label: Career-route check
about.text: GRC Analyst is a relevant career path for CSE - Cyber Security, particularly for students interested in cybersecurity governance, risk assessment, audits and compliance rather than hands-on penetration testing.

blocks.label: Career progression

blocks.text: Typical progression varies by employer, industry, certification and experience.
PhD routes

Progress toward enterprise cyber-risk and governance leadership. Develop expertise in AI governance, cloud risk, privacy, third-party risk, regulatory change, security metrics and board-level technology-risk communication. The long-term value comes from connecting technical controls with organisational risk rather than focusing only on compliance checklists.
